details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:? | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: phase-cap lookup can compare a recovery count against None when MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE is unset, causing a runtime TypeError.
  WHY: all three reviewers identified the same crash path; severity is elevated to the highest reported level.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: paginated check-runs collected with gh api --paginate --slurp may remain nested and downstream jq processing can miss failed check-runs.
  WHY: all three reviewers warned the slurped pagination output must be flattened before iterating over individual check-runs.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: convergence detection can misclassify mixed or prior-run states as ledger-only equivalent.
  WHY: the aggregate applied/already_applied logic does not clearly distinguish per-reviewer state or prior autofix history.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: healthy-PR lookback may compare runner-local time against UTC timestamps and misclassify commits.
  WHY: all reviewers agreed the timestamp arithmetic needs UTC/epoch consistency.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: first-iteration empty-output retry may not remain bounded to a single retry.
  WHY: if retry state is not persisted across steps, the workflow can re-enter the retry path.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: rb_judge execution failures are treated the same as verdicts and can still mark linked issues review-blocked.
  WHY: transient failures like network timeouts or rate limits need distinct handling to avoid persistent review-blocked labels.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE=99 removes the practical safety cap for ai:done recovery loops, risking excessive compute if the loop never converges.
  WHY: both reviewers called out the operational risk, though one noted it may be intentional rather than a bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:? | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: phase-cap lookup compares against None when the env var is unset.
  WHY: Python will raise a TypeError if the code compares the recovery count against a None default.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: check-runs pagination JSON handling may not flatten paginated output correctly.
  WHY: downstream jq filters can iterate over page arrays instead of individual check-runs.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: convergence detection can misclassify mixed states or prior-run states.
  WHY: the applied=0 and already_applied>=1 logic does not account for all reviewer-file combinations.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: timezone-naive timestamp comparison can misclassify commits in the healthy-PR lookback.
  WHY: runner-local time arithmetic is being compared against UTC commit timestamps.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: the first-iteration empty-output retry may not stay bounded to one retry.
  WHY: if the retry state is not persisted, the workflow could re-enter the retry path unexpectedly.
- PR description:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the test plan is incomplete.
  WHY: the two listed end-to-end/pagination verification items remain unchecked.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:? | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: the phase-cap lookup can compare recovery counts against None when MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE is unset.
  WHY: Python raises TypeError when comparing an int with None.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: check-runs pagination output shape can be nested incorrectly after gh api --paginate --slurp.
  WHY: downstream jq filters may iterate over page arrays instead of individual check-run objects unless the slurped output is flattened.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the 24-hour healthy-PR lookback may be timezone-naive.
  WHY: comparing runner-local time against UTC GitHub timestamps can offset the lookback window.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: convergence detection edge cases can mis-handle mixed reviewer states and prior autofix runs.
  WHY: aggregate counts do not clearly separate per-reviewer state from prior-run history.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the first-iteration empty-output retry may not remain bounded.
  WHY: without persisted retry state, the workflow could retry more than once across step re-executions.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: setting MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE to 99 effectively removes the safety net for ai:done recovery loops.
  WHY: a stuck loop could burn substantial compute before escalating, even though the intent is to let the ladder complete naturally.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: rb_judge failures are not distinguished from actual verdicts when labeling review-blocked.
  WHY: transient infrastructure failures can still end up applying ai:review-blocked labels that require manual cleanup.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:? | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: if MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE is unset and defaults to None, numeric comparison in the phase-cap lookup will raise TypeError.
  WHY: Python comparisons like recovery_count >= cap cannot compare an int with None.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: the check-runs collection step may leave paginated output in an array-of-arrays shape.
  WHY: gh api --paginate --slurp requires explicit flattening before jq filters can process individual check-runs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the healthy-PR lookback can compare local-time arithmetic against UTC timestamps.
  WHY: the window can shift if the runner does not normalize to UTC or epoch seconds.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: convergence detection does not clearly handle mixed states or prior autofix history.
  WHY: the logic should distinguish current-run state from cumulative already_applied counts.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:? | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: the first-iteration empty-output retry guard may not persist across invocations.
  WHY: a local-step counter would not survive step restarts unless written to workflow state.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:? | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: setting the ai:done recovery cap to 99 removes most of the intended safety cap.
  WHY: this is likely an intentional trade-off, but it still creates operational risk if the loop never converges.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
